anchor.note: Preserve the original PixelLab canvas coordinates; the crouch and downward travel are intentional and must not be body-height-normalized.

approval.note: Raheem: 'I absolutely love this.' Phaser owns the draw flash, ground-slap impact, rune, dust, and camera response.

runtimeNotes: The generated card is a blocking prop. Phaser may layer the player's actual selected card above it.
Use per-frame durations rather than a uniform frame rate so the starting presentation and final palm-down pose hold long enough to read.
Do not loop during gameplay; trigger once and resolve from the final held pose.
